//: Production overrides for devnet.khaneazam.com (Plesk). Layered on top of appsettings.json by ASP.NET Core when ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Production. Committed with real secrets on purpose — same call as .env.local.

Scraper.//: Same key used for local dev. Capped at 100 Places Text Search requests/day unless billing is enabled on the Cloud project — searches fall back to OpenStreetMap once that's exhausted, they don't fail.

Swagger.//: Open with no credentials. RequireAuthentication must be explicitly false, not just Username/Password removed — with no credentials and RequireAuthentication still true, the middleware fails closed (404) rather than publishing anonymously.

EmailValidation.//: EnableSmtpProbe/EnableBounceCheck stay false here by default (see appsettings.json) even with credentials configured — flip them on explicitly once you're ready to run those passes in production.
